answer: Charge redundancy, not entry. Each submission is measured against all texts already accepted by normalized compression distance; it clears only if its nearest neighbour exceeds 0.85, with fixed slots. A farm driving one prompt through a thousand keys grows one crystal: same lattice, so the copies fold onto one point and share one slot. A real admission must stand far from the rest, so it carries an observation the pool does not hold yet, gathered and checked alone. Planks from one timber share their grain; publishing the nadir of the distance distribution shows how far the bar moved.
